plain.value: How the series 2 production office and base work.

pages.title: Lamplighter S2 production handbook
pages.body: Start here: who is who, where base is and how the office runs.

pages.title: Crew induction
pages.body: Every new starter reads the base safety briefing and signs the induction sheet before their first call.

pages.title: Unit base rules
pages.body: Speed limit 5 mph at base. Smoking only at the marked point behind the catering truck.

pages.title: Radio etiquette
pages.body: Channel 1 production, 2 camera and sound, 3 sparks and grips, 4 art. Keep traffic short.

pages.title: Expenses and petty cash
pages.body: Receipts in the envelope with your name; floats reconciled every Thursday.

pages.title: Script revision colours
pages.body: White, blue, pink, yellow, green, goldenrod, buff, salmon, cherry.

pages.title: Lost property
pages.body: Lost property lives in the office cabin; anything unclaimed after a month goes to charity.

pages.title: Press and social media
pages.body: No photos of cast, set or scripts on personal social media. Press enquiries go to the publicist.

pages.title: Wrap party 2026
pages.body: Saturday 12 December at the Assembly Rooms, from 19:30. Plus-ones welcome, names to Marisol by 1 December.
